reviewer: GPT-5.6 Sol xhigh independent audit instance
findings: Independent reconstruction of all 128 unique case-arm rows produced 64 complete paired cases and no missing or duplicate arm. All requests contain the frozen 4096-token prompt, n_predict=8, stream=true, temperature=0, top_k=1, seed=0 and cache_prompt=false; prompt bytes and SHA-256 agree within every pair, and execution order alternates OFF-first and ON-first exactly as preregistered.

Physical route evidence is internally complete: all 64 OFF rows report dense mode with 16/16 blocks and 4096/4096 prompt tokens, while all 64 ON rows report selected_block mode with 8/16 blocks and 2048/4096 prompt tokens. Final streamed responses retain the same telemetry, route observation is 128/128, the server log has 65 selected-block events including the warm-up, and llama.cpp timings report cache_n=0 for every measured request. This excludes prompt-cache or LCP reuse as the explanation for the observed prompt-token reduction.

The three uncommitted slop.cpp source files hash exactly to the receipt ledger. Static inspection shows an environment-gated, text-only experimental path that deletes unselected 256-token blocks before ordinary dense prefill; for 16 blocks it retains indices [0,2,4,6,8,10,12,15]. It does not implement sparse-attention kernels, preserve original positional indices or establish a production deployment. The retained_attention_fraction telemetry name is broader than the mechanism: the value is the retained token-block fraction.

Fresh read-only hashing matched the executed binary at /home/augus/build/slop-slx08/bin/llama-server (4395a601202ec76bcaef1d10db97849a92b311d8c31e4afce4d8b961609807a1) and the GGUF model (bee238bbeb3dc0a34bde4d0dedbaee1f98c009e8bb4226f03070054c12fb1372). The custom telemetry, exact 4096-token precondition and retained prompt-token counts additionally bind the measurements to the experimental runtime path. No new inference was run during review.

Independent scoring reproduces dense 38/64=0.59375 and selected-block 28/64=0.4375. Pair outcomes are 27 both-correct, 11 dense-only, 1 selected-block-only and 25 neither, giving delta -10/64=-0.15625. The frozen normal paired CI is [-0.2559727058174594,-0.0565272941825406]; an independent 20,000-resample paired bootstrap with the frozen audit seed gives [-0.25,-0.0625]. Both are wholly below the -0.03 noninferiority margin, so the negative decision is not a borderline interval artifact.

The worker scorer selects the first standalone single digit, but a stricter whole-response single-digit scorer produces exactly the same 38/64 and 28/64 accuracies on the retained responses. Therefore the permissive scorer does not reverse this result. The cap remains consequential: 11 selected-block responses and 1 dense response stop at the n_predict=8 limit. Absolute semantic floors fail badly for both arms, so this run cannot estimate uncapped model quality or attribute all quality loss intrinsically to compaction.

TTFT recomputation matches the preregistered statistics: median of the 64 paired dense/selected ratios is 1.9272955486646213; ratio of marginal linearly interpolated p95 values is 1.750475331773813; selected-block is faster in 64/64 pairs. The p95 of the pairwise ratios is instead 1.985704059327857, so paired_p95_ttft_speedup is an imprecise label for the frozen marginal-p95 ratio. Both definitions pass. Even/odd order strata retain median speedups of 1.7592578609514606 and 1.962303728976366, respectively, although the difference warns against extrapolating a hardware-wide performance constant.

Streamed TTFT is host monotonic time to the first nonempty streamed content chunk, including leading-newline content; it is not time to the answer digit. There is no preregistered confidence interval for TTFT. Approval therefore preserves only the observed bounded campaign result, not a latency guarantee, throughput claim or production qualification.

Stable restoration identity is exact before versus after for the complete systemd ExecStart, gateway role, active model qwen38 and health state; PID/start time are correctly treated as volatile. Embedding health is HTTP 200. The terminal is valid and SEALED with 128 samples, no active lock, a complete hash-chained journal through RESTORED and SEALED, and an exact terminal file manifest. The watcher records the matching run_id, worker return code 0, no timeout or early failure, legal IMPLEMENTED-to-EXECUTED advancement and final 8080/8081 health 200.

Receipt SHA-256 ed54519837bf23f174fcf4fdeef451a5d8e776fc8d3857b91b5e61b5190eb4eb, fingerprint e940c70f03731896eae4e4a377c3a78a9d9cdc5fca14858a8cb4eea4f94fa717, preregistration SHA-256 and implementation digest recompute exactly. Thirty-three of 34 provenance inputs remain byte-identical. The sole unavailable entry is raw/.experiment-run.lock, an ephemeral 95-byte coordination file recorded while the ExperimentRun context was active and necessarily removed on clean exit; terminal validation explicitly requires its absence. Recording that lock is a packaging defect, but it is neither scientific input nor decision evidence and does not undermine this negative claim. Future receipt generation should exclude ephemeral lock files with a local guard.

All gates are conjunctive. Route observation, physical retention, TTFT speedups, service restoration and embedding health pass; dense semantic floor, selected-block semantic floor and semantic noninferiority fail. The authorized claim is therefore only SLX08_PHYSICAL_SELECTED_BLOCK_PREFILL_REJECTED_R5: under this frozen 64-pair, 4096-token, single-digit, n_predict=8 campaign, physical server-side token-block compaction halved evaluated prompt tokens and reduced streamed TTFT but failed the absolute and paired semantic gates. It does not support generic sparse attention, arbitrary contexts/tasks, uncapped quality, causal attribution solely to block selection, CUDA-kernel efficiency or production readiness.
